artifacts.heading: ERD-001

sections.title: Background and Goals
sections.text: An employee books a meeting room by email today and double booking happens weekly. Goal: self-service book with conflict checks and automatic release.

sections.title: Users
sections.text: employee: wants to book a meeting room. admin: needs the daily view. system: will release no-show booking records.

sections.title: An employee can book a meeting room without overlapping time slot
sections.text: An employee can book a meeting room for a time slot. Two booking records on the same meeting room must not overlap. A new booking is booked and is synced to the calendar service.

sections.title: check in within 15 minutes or the system will release the meeting room
sections.text: The employee must check in within 15 minutes after the start. Otherwise the system will release the booking, marks it released and updates the calendar service.

sections.title: An admin can view daily booking records
sections.text: An admin can view all booking records of a day for every meeting room.

sections.title: Non-functional Requirements
sections.text: With 100 concurrent requests for the same time slot, exactly one booking succeeds.

sections.title: Acceptance
sections.text:
- the time slot is free → the employee books the meeting room → a booking is booked
- the time slot overlaps another booking → the employee books the meeting room → the response is 409 SLOT_TAKEN
- a booking is booked → the employee checks in within 15 minutes → the booking is checked-in
- no check in after 15 minutes → the system job runs → the booking is released and the calendar service is updated
- booking records exist today → the admin opens the daily view → rows are grouped by meeting room

AC-001-1.text:
# AC-001-1
Given the time slot is free
When the employee books the meeting room
Then a booking is booked

AC-001-2.text:
# AC-001-2
Given the time slot overlaps another booking
When the employee books the meeting room
Then the response is 409 SLOT_TAKEN

AC-002-1.text:
# AC-002-1
Given a booking is booked
When the employee checks in within 15 minutes
Then the booking is checked-in

AC-002-2.text:
# AC-002-2
Given no check in after 15 minutes
When the system job runs
Then the booking is released and the calendar service is updated

AC-003-1.text:
# AC-003-1
Given booking records exist today
When the admin opens the daily view
Then rows are grouped by meeting room

UC-001.heading: UC-001 An employee can book a meeting room without overlapping time slot (REQ-001)
UC-001.text:
- Primary actor: employee
- Trigger: the employee books the meeting room
- Precondition: the time slot is free
- Postcondition (success guarantee): a booking is booked
- Main flow:
  1. the employee books the meeting room
  2. a booking is booked
- Alternative flow: none
- Exception flow: the response is 409 SLOT_TAKEN

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  S(["employee"]) --> P["the employee books the meeting room"] --> Q["a booking is booked"]
  P -.-> X["the response is 409 SLOT_TAKEN"]
```

UC-002.heading: UC-002 check in within 15 minutes or the system will release the meeting room (REQ-002)
UC-002.text:
- Primary actor: employee
- Trigger: the employee checks in within 15 minutes
- Precondition: a booking is booked
- Postcondition (success guarantee): the booking is checked-in
- Main flow:
  1. the employee checks in within 15 minutes
  2. the booking is checked-in
- Alternative flow: none
- Exception flow: the booking is released and the calendar service is updated

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  S(["employee"]) --> P["the employee checks in within 15 minutes"] --> Q["the booking is checked-in"]
  P -.-> X["the booking is released and the calendar service is updated"]
```

UC-003.heading: UC-003 An admin can view daily booking records (REQ-003)
UC-003.text:
- Primary actor: admin
- Trigger: the admin opens the daily view
- Precondition: booking records exist today
- Postcondition (success guarantee): rows are grouped by meeting room
- Main flow:
  1. the admin opens the daily view
  2. rows are grouped by meeting room
- Alternative flow: none
- Exception flow: none

flowchart LR
